scope: Full text of seven staged migration files read for publication privacy and embedded third-party material. No private values or imported attribution blocks observed. Not database correctness, production permission or legal certification; no SQL executed.

Audit-chain fields, heads, anchors and trigger functions; no concrete anchors, keys, external destinations or customer data. This content review does not certify nullable-field enforcement.
Tenant-scoped foreign keys and lineage constraints; deterministic backfill derives tenant from existing adapter rows, not embedded private seed data.
